items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The neutral colours, light and dark, with success and warning, and a font family per Geist weight, in the form the engine compiles, and the fonts map that loads them.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn, which joins class values and lets a later Tailwind class win over an earlier one.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: usePresence, which keeps an overlay drawn while it animates in and out, useReducedMotion, which reads whether the system asks for reduced motion, usePopupMotion, the fade, grow and slide a menu, popover or tooltip opens and closes with, useSwipeToDismiss, the swipe that closes a toast, and usePulse, the fade a title pulses with while its work is under way.

items.name: overlay
items.title: Overlay
items.description: usePortalHostCheck, which reports in development an overlay shown while no PortalHost draws it, and useModalOverlay and useModalOverlayShown, which keep screen readers inside an open modal overlay.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: useHighlight, which tracks whether a menu item is under a finger, the pointer or the keyboard's focus, pressClosing, what pressing an item does to its menu, webItemRole, an item's role on the web, and useMenuScrollHeight, the height a device scrolls a menu's items past.

items.name: command-score
items.title: Command score
items.description: commandScore, cmdk's fuzzy scorer, which Command filters its items with: how well the typed letters match a value and its keywords, in order.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Text that takes the text classes of the container around it, such as a Button's label colour.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: A lucide icon sized and coloured by its classes, matching the label of the container around it.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A pressable control announced as a button, in the style's variants and sizes.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A one-pixel rule between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, hidden from screen readers unless it marks a real boundary.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A muted placeholder block that pulses while content loads.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The text that names a field, with a nativeID for the field's aria-labelledby and an onPress for the caller to focus it.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small pill for a status or a count, in the style's variants, with its label and icon taking the variant's colours.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, title, description, content and footer, in the style's default and small spacing.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture of a person or account in three sizes, with a fallback that shows when the image is missing or fails to load.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar showing how far a task has got from 0 to 100, announced as a progress bar with its value.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value, or a range of values, picked by dragging a thumb along a track, each thumb announced as adjustable with its value.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month's grid of days on which a day, several days or a range is selected, with today marked and buttons to the previous and next month.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides that a swipe or its named previous and next buttons scroll through one snap at a time, with Embla's api.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels side by side or stacked, sized in percent of their group, with handles that drag the room between two, each announced as adjustable and moved by the arrow keys on the web.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toasts raised with toast() from anywhere into a Toaster at the app's root, stacked, closed by a timer, a swipe or their buttons, and read by screen readers.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field in the style's look, with a focus border, an invalid state and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multiline text field at least four lines tall, with the same focus, invalid and disabled states as Input.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off control in the style's default and small sizes, announced as a switch, with an invalid border and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box with a check mark when checked, announced as a checkbox, with an invalid border and a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: A column of round choices of which one is selected, announced as radios, with an invalid border and a dimmed disabled state per item or for the group.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button in the style's default and outline variants and three sizes, on the muted background while pressed, announced as a button that is selected while pressed, with a dimmed disabled state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A row or column of toggles of which one or several are pressed, spaced apart or joined into one bar, announced as radios or checkboxes.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Panels switched by a row of tabs, on a muted bar or underlined, of which only the selected panel is rendered, announced as a tab list of tabs.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A circle that turns while something loads, announced as a busy progress bar named Loading, standing still when the system is set to reduce motion.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An input with text, icons or buttons beside, above or below it, drawn as one field that takes the focus, invalid and disabled states of its input.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code in a row of slots, typed, pasted or filled from a texted code into one hidden field, with a caret on the next slot and an invalid state.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut drawn as a small muted cap, alone or with the other keys of a shortcut in a group.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A bordered box announced as an alert, with a title, a description, an optional icon beside them and an optional action at the top right, in a default or destructive variant.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A centred placeholder for a screen or section with nothing to show yet, with media, a title, a description and actions.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A frame whose height follows its width at a given ratio, for an image, a video or a map.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail from the top of the app to the current screen, a navigation landmark of links and separators with the current page marked.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons, and the text and separators beside them, joined into one control in a row or a column, announced as a group.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: The pages of a long list, a navigation landmark of page links with the current page outlined and marked, previous and next links and an ellipsis.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of content with media, a title, a description and actions, outlined or muted at three sizes, and a group that lists items.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A box of fixed size whose content scrolls inside it, vertically or sideways, with the platform scroll indicator.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of data announced as a table, with a header, a body, a footer and a caption, its cells sharing each row and the table scrolling sideways when wider than its box.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: The layout of a form: fields of a label, a control and a description or an error, in groups and sets named by a legend, stacked or in a row.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A region shown and hidden by a trigger announced as a button with its expanded state, closed or open by default or controlled.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of sections whose triggers, announced as buttons with their expanded state, open one section at a time or several, each growing open and shrinking closed unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A dialog that interrupts to confirm or acknowledge something, announced as a modal alertdialog named by its title, which a press outside it does not close, with a cancel button that does and an action button, fading in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window centred over a dimmed screen, announced as a modal dialog named by its title, closed by its close buttons, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel attached to one edge of the screen over a dimmed overlay, announced as a modal dialog named by its title, closed by its close buttons, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, sliding in from its side unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel attached to an edge of the screen over a dimmed overlay, announced as a modal dialog named by its title, closed by a swipe toward its edge, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, sliding in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel beside its trigger, announced as a dialog named by its title, closed by its trigger, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Links to the app's sections in a navigation landmark, with triggers that open a panel of more links on a press, or as the pointer rests on them on the web, one at a time, closed by a second press, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app's side navigation: a sheet below the md width and a panel beside the screen from it, collapsing off the screen or to a rail of icons, with its open state in a provider, a toggle button, groups and menus.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label beside a control, opened by a press on a device and by hover or focus on the web, announced as a tooltip, closed by its trigger, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview of what a link leads to, beside it, opened by a press on a device and by hover on the web, closed by its trigger, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions that opens from its trigger, with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and sub-menus, announced as a menu and closed by an item, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions on an area of the screen, opened by a long press or a right click where it landed, with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and sub-menus, announced as a menu and closed by an item, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A bar of menus, one open at a time, each with checkbox and radio items, groups, shortcuts and sub-menus, announced as a menubar of menus and closed by an item, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A field that picks one of a list of options, announced as a combobox whose options carry their selected state, showing the chosen option's label, closed by a choice, a press outside it, the back button or Escape, fading and growing in unless the system asks for reduced motion.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A menu of commands searched by typing, whose typed text filters its items by cmdk's fuzzy score on value and keywords, highlighting the first match, moved by the arrow keys and run by the return key, with groups hidden while none of their items match, and a CommandDialog that holds it in a Dialog.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that picks one of a long list of choices: a trigger announced as a combobox showing the chosen label, opening a Popover that holds a Command whose typed text filters the choices, the chosen one announced as selected with a check mark, closed by a choice.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: DirectionProvider and useDirection: the direction text reads in, the system's unless a provider sets it, which the web also lays its children out in; useDirectionSides, which way an item runs and the style keys and sides it places its parts by; and useMirrored, the style that turns an arrow for text read right to left.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: Upstream's NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption and NativeSelectOptGroup drawn with Select: a combobox showing its first option until another is chosen, opening a list of its options and named groups.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: No files, as upstream's: a form is Field bound to a form library, such as react-hook-form's Controller.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Upstream's base-ui toast: a Toaster at the app's root and a toast manager whose add, update, close and promise raise toasts from anywhere, stacked, closed by a timeout, a swipe or their close button, and read by screen readers.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Recharts' chart parts in Recharts' names, drawn with react-native-svg: bar, line, area, pie, radar and radial bar charts with their axes, grid, tooltip and legend, coloured through the palette a ChartContainer provides.

items.name: color-scheme
items.title: Color scheme
items.description: useColorScheme, which reads the colour scheme the app draws, light or dark, as the engine holds it.

items.name: chart-theme
items.title: Chart theme
items.description: useChartTheme, which reads the colour scheme the app draws and the theme colours a chart names, such as var(--chart-1), as the engine holds them.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Charts drawn in the colours and labels of a chart config, with a tooltip a press, a pointer or the arrow keys move, a legend, and the values read to screen readers.

items.name: use-highlighted-code
items.title: Use highlighted code
items.description: useHighlightedCode, which highlights code with Shiki's JavaScript engine into one node per line for a CodeBlockLine, in the light or dark theme the app draws, loading each language the first time it is used.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers, highlighted lines and a copy button that tells screen readers it copied; long lines scroll sideways unless they wrap.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file or an image in a card, with its upload state, three sizes, a horizontal or vertical layout, actions, a press area over the whole card, and a row that scrolls sideways.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A line in a conversation that is not a message: a status announced as it changes, a system note, a row ruled underneath, or a label between two lines.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One message in a conversation: an avatar beside its bubbles, with a header and a footer, on either side of the row.

items.name: focus-visible
items.title: Focus visible
items.description: useFocusVisible, which says whether a control's focus came from the keyboard, so a focus ring is drawn for it and not after a press.

items.name: message-context
items.title: Message context
items.description: useMessage, which tells a Bubble or an Attachment the side of the Message it sits in, and lets a ghost Bubble tell the Message it is there.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A message's framed surface in seven variants, at the start or end of the row, with reactions overlapping its edge and content that can take a press.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: A password field over Input Group whose toggle, named Show password or Hide password, shows or hides the password.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password strength
items.description: How strong a password is, as a three-step meter announced when it changes, and which of its requirements it meets, in a small card.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: A six-character one-time code over Input OTP, as one group of six slots or two groups of three, with 48 high slots that fill the row.

items.name: unsaved-changes-toolbar
items.title: Unsaved changes toolbar
items.description: A toolbar floating at the top or bottom of its parent while a form has unsaved changes, with a live message and Reset and Save buttons that are disabled while saving.

items.name: tab-bar
items.title: Tab bar
items.description: A bar of top-level destinations at one edge of the screen, a tablist of pressable tab items with an indicator, an icon, a label and a count badge.
